headline: ⚠️ Beware of misleading claims
full_text:
⚠️ Beware of misleading claims

A video circulating on social media claims that thermocol has been used in the construction of the Delhi-Amritsar-Katra Expressway.

#PIBFactCheck

❌ This claim is #Misleading .

✅ The white material is a compressible filler provided at the expansion joint near the crash barrier/friction slab. It is a non-load-bearing component used in accordance with IRC Codes and MoRTH Specifications to accommodate the thermal expansion and contraction of the bridge structure.

✅ Its presence is a standard engineering practice and does not indicate any construction defect or compromise in the structural safety of the bridge.

⚠️ Always rely only on official sources for verified information.
